read_for.locus: Section 1.1, Eq. (1): the mean square displacement is 2dDt, d the spatial dimension (Einstein's relation); Section 1.2, Eqs. (3) and (15): its long-time limit

Section 2.1, Eq. (18): at long times the mean square displacement goes as t^alpha, alpha not 1 being anomalous; alpha = 1 normal diffusion, below it subdiffusion, above it superdiffusion; Section 3.1: alpha = 2 ballistic
